verdict.rationale: Skills are defined as plain directories containing a `SKILL.md` of YAML frontmatter plus Markdown, with optional scripts/, references/ and assets/ folders. Anthropic publishes this as the open Agent Skills standard "for cross-platform portability" that "works across multiple AI tools." Community users confirm skills are "just .md files," and one points Codex at a repo's skill directory. Missing for 10: hands-on evidence of a skill running unmodified in a named non-Claude harness, and clarity on whether Claude-specific frontmatter or plugin-manifest features carry over.
